answer: Reputation is discounted with an exponential half-life, so influence persists only through sustained honest service, not a burst of fabricated endorsements. Under EigenTrust-style matrix factorization, a freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality; without reciprocal trust paths from established peers, it cannot amplify its score through transitivity or pass consensus thresholds. Like a vine anchored to a jetty amid an ocean, trust must attach to durable, verified relationships.
